turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to figure out which transit pass to buy for the month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold your thoughts until I've described all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a monthly unlimited pass, which pays off if I ride more than about twice a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a pay as you go card, which is cheaper if I only ride a few times a week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a weekly pass, which I could buy only for the weeks I'm busy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How many days a week do you usually ride? If it's four or five, get the monthly pass. If it's only one or two, pay as you go is the way to go.
